title: Cancellation, Closing and Refund Destinations Across Set-Aside Account Plans
content:
These are the plan settings of Set-Aside Accounts for ending a set-aside — by the borrower's cancellation or by the end of the loan — and for where a payee refund goes.

## Cancellation by the borrower

| Plan | Borrower may cancel by signed request | Calendar months after establishment before a cancellation is accepted | Refused while the loan carries an unrepaid property-charge corporate advance | Where the unused balance goes on cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory) | No | 0 (cancellation not permitted) | Yes | Not applicable |
| Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) | Yes | 12 | Yes | The HECM available line of credit |
| Partially Funded LESA | No | 0 (cancellation not permitted) | Yes | Not applicable |
| Repair Set-Aside | No | 0 (cancellation not permitted) | Yes | Not applicable |
| Servicing Fee Set-Aside | No | 0 (cancellation not permitted) | Yes | Not applicable |
| Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve | Yes | 24 | Yes | A reduction of the loan balance |

## Loan termination and refunds

| Plan | Closes when the loan is paid in full or terminated | A payee refund while the set-aside is active or depleted is credited to | A payee refund received after the set-aside is closed is applied as |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory) | Yes | The set-aside | A reduction of the loan balance |
| Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) | Yes | The set-aside | A reduction of the loan balance |
| Partially Funded LESA | Yes | The set-aside | A reduction of the loan balance |
| Repair Set-Aside | Yes | The set-aside | A reduction of the loan balance |
| Servicing Fee Set-Aside | Yes | The set-aside | A reduction of the loan balance |
| Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve | Yes | The set-aside | A reduction of the loan balance |

## Notes

- Only two plans can be cancelled by the borrower: the Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected), from 12 calendar months after establishment, and the Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, from 24 calendar months after establishment.
- The released balance of a cancelled Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) goes back to the HECM available line; that of a cancelled Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve reduces the Summit loan balance.
